styles.name: Screen and face
styles.what: Your screen on top, you below, and the number or key phrase lands between them from the first frame.
styles.why: A screenshot next to your face is the one format that has grown your Instagram.
styles.give: A talking video of you, plus a screen recording of what you are talking about.
styles.min_input: A talking video of 10 to 20 seconds about one thing, plus a screen recording or screenshot of that thing.
styles.record: Talk to the camera for 10 to 20 seconds about one thing you did on screen, then record that screen.

styles.name: Receipts
styles.what: Paper receipts land on the claim: what it cost then, what it costs now. A proven reel edit, set in your brand kit.
styles.why: The proof is on screen the moment you say it.
styles.give: A talking video where you compare a before and an after number, plus a screen recording.
styles.min_input: A talking video where you say a then-and-now pair of numbers, what it cost or took before and what it costs or takes now.
styles.record: Say the old price or time and the new one in one breath, for example "that took eight weeks, now it takes twenty minutes".

styles.name: Documentary
styles.what: A wide cinema frame, slow push-ins and candlelight. A figure below counts as you say it.
styles.why: The most cinematic of the set.
styles.give: A talking video. A number in what you say makes it land.
styles.min_input: A talking video of 8 to 20 seconds about one thing.
styles.record: A calm, seated take in a warm room works best. Any of your existing videos can be used.

styles.name: Words in the room
styles.what: Your words on the wall behind you, with you in front of them.
styles.why: Premium and calm, and the key words are there from the first frame.
styles.give: A talking video shot on a tripod, with some wall showing behind you.
styles.min_input: A talking video of 8 to 18 seconds shot on a tripod, with some wall showing beside or above your head.
styles.record: Keep the camera still and leave space on the wall beside or above your head.

styles.name: Cutout
styles.what: You cut out on black, with a new picture on each key word.
styles.why: The fastest pace in the set.
styles.give: A well-lit talking video, plus screen recordings or photos for the pictures.
styles.min_input: A well-lit talking video of 8 to 18 seconds with you on camera the whole time, plus three to five pictures (screen recordings, screenshots or photos).
styles.record: Light your face and hair well and wear something that stands apart from the background.

styles.name: The art of
styles.what: An object-grid carousel: the topic ringed by real objects and two cutouts of you, then one idea per slide with six captioned objects.
styles.why: A format that is working on Instagram right now, with your face on it twice.
styles.give: A topic and your lines (from one of your videos or typed), and a video or photos of you.
styles.min_input: A topic with at least three parts and about six short lines of yours for each part, so 18 lines or more, from a video or typed.
styles.record: Nothing new is needed. For new poses, a few sharp photos of you against a plain wall.

sets.title: The art of building your brand
The art of being a team of one

styles.name: Prompt pack
styles.what: A raked-sand cover that draws itself while you speak, then your prompts, one per slide, ready to copy.
styles.why: Prompt carousels are your best-performing slideshow type.
styles.give: Your prompts, and one short voice line for the moving cover.
styles.min_input: One to five of your prompts, word for word, typed or read out in a video.
styles.record: Nothing new is needed if the prompts are in one of your videos.

styles.name: Field notes
styles.what: Your steps typed on cream paper, with taped prints of your screen and of you.
styles.why: Your process, shown the way you did it.
styles.give: Your steps (from a video or typed), a few screen frames and a photo of you.
styles.min_input: Three or more short lines or steps of yours, typed or from a video, and a photo or frame of you for the cover.
styles.record: Nothing new is needed if you walked through the steps in a video.

styles.name: Top 5
styles.what: A countdown list with your real screens, one item per slide.
styles.why: Lists are your biggest format ever.
styles.give: A list of five things, and screen frames or footage for each.
styles.min_input: A list of at least three things, typed or from a video, with a picture for each: your screen or a moment of your video.
styles.record: Nothing new is needed if the list comes from one of your videos.

styles.name: Zen garden
styles.what: One overhead shot of black sand. Stones are ringed as you speak, and one red stone rises on your last line.
styles.why: Calm and yours: the garden from your brand origin.
styles.give: A short voice line, 10 to 20 seconds, from any of your videos.
styles.min_input: A voice line of 10 to 20 seconds from any of your videos.

styles.name: Your feed
styles.what: Your real posts between identical grey ones, until yours lifts out of the feed.
styles.why: Your own work as the proof.
styles.give: A screen recording scrolling through your own posts, and a short voice line.
styles.min_input: A voice line of 10 to 20 seconds, plus a screen recording scrolling slowly through your own posts.
styles.record: Record your screen while you scroll slowly through your own posts.

styles.name: Moving type
styles.what: Your words set as a moving typeset page, ending on the line that matters, struck or marked in red.
styles.why: Clean and readable with the sound off.
styles.give: A short voice line, 10 to 20 seconds, from any of your videos.
styles.min_input: A voice line of 10 to 20 seconds from any of your videos, best with a number in it.
